correctness.rationale: The commutator row identity holds for any loopless quiver, and elimination leaves weighted oriented incidence rows. Their rank is the graphic matroid rank over every field. Monochromatic-edge sets are flats and proper colorings of their contractions are q^c times the characteristic polynomial, proving each coefficient. The unicyclic additive-character calculation and unique all-nonzero cycle correction were rederived; 17 exhaustive independently implemented finite-field graph cases agree. Reversing an arrow negates a scheme-ideal generator. The triangle quotient weight-relation vectors are inequivalent in odd characteristic, proving its two commutator Lie algebras nonisomorphic. Infinite claims rest on proof, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The number of centralizers of each codimension and their whole finite-field distribution form natural associative-algebra invariants. The formula expresses every such coefficient through well-studied graphic matroid minors, yielding genuinely nontrivial exact results for all unicyclic quivers rather than isolated computations. Exact commuting schemes survive all orientation changes even though a triangle pair is Lie-nonisomorphic, establishing a concrete reconstruction boundary with structural meaning. The unicyclic cycle-dependence correction is substantive, not a routine renaming or small numerical gain.
